issueCommentThread.body:
UAT: **focused-test-pass-1**

`nheroux-bit` cannot apply labels on this repo (`AddLabelsToLabelable` denied). Please add the `focused-test-pass-1` label to this issue.

Adoption blocker.

This is about Planning: the conversation before any code. Directive is supposed to learn what the person wants, write down the project, and agree the scope before an agent starts building.

What a new person hits: They answer the setup questions, and the answers cannot be saved because the session is not allowed to write.

Why that ruins the product for them: The form was wasted. They did the part that feels like work, and the product kept none of it.

How likely: High whenever setup is started from a host that opens the session as read-only. That is a normal first launch, not an edge case.

The fallback sentence is "host session identity is unavailable" and the next sentence is "Directive cannot bind the occupancy claim without a stable host owner". The issue quote "lacks the host-provided session identity required for writes" is the session paraphrase of that deny, not a second string in the tree. CHANGELOG at this SHA does not name #4660. blocks-the-design: Setup Phase 1 persists USER.md, and the recorded Codex command is the non-claiming read-only start.

Evidence. Pin b6425115eab5a25877735acd70ca7d693594dda8. Phase 1 is the USER.md write (content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md:183) to `%APPDATA%\deft\USER.md` on Windows (SKILL.md:124). Issue 4660 records that write. Project identity is Phase 2 (SKILL.md:414). The proposed brief is Phase 3 (SKILL.md:639). Codex already has a host owner source: payload `session_id`, stored as `host:codex:v1:` (packages/core/src/session/host-session-owner.ts:30). `requiresOwner` is false when the verb is `session:start` and the command is read-only (packages/core/src/hooks/classify/host-session-identity.ts:523). The four-token form `deft session:start -- --read-only` is that case (packages/core/src/hooks/classify/host-session-identity.test.ts:331, :338). `attachLifecycleIdentityRewrite` returns the prior decision before any identity deny when `requiresOwner` is false (packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts:2565). A Codex hook with an empty environment allows `deft session:start --read-only` (packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.test.ts:3579). The sentences "host session identity is unavailable" and "Directive cannot bind the occupancy claim without a stable host owner" sit on the owner-requiring arm (dispatcher.ts:2597). A direct write takes `occupancy-identity-unavailable` only when a live occupant is present and the actor is unresolved (dispatcher.ts:1547). No live lease allows the occupancy gate (packages/core/src/session/occupancy.ts:1779). Init seeds PROJECT-DEFINITION and leaves an existing file intact (packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.ts:262). Phase 2 skips that file unless the user asks to replace it (SKILL.md:420).

Failure mode. A lean that binds the recorded sentence repairs Phase 1 and a missing Codex identity contract. Phase 1's file is the out-of-project USER.md write the issue recorded. The lifecycle command the issue recorded is allowed with no host owner, so supplying an owner there leaves PROJECT-DEFINITION on the init seed. `seedMinimalProjectDefinition` keeps an existing file. Claiming an owner inside read-only `session:start` removes the #3611 alignment exemption. Adding a Codex environment variable uses the channel host-session-owner.ts:36 refuses for payload hosts (#4431): the value is shell-reachable and shared across agent sessions. Owner ids are cooperative and same-user forgeable (host-session-owner.ts:6), so a project-identity write with no bound lease is a write any same-user process can perform while this session holds nothing.

Disposition. The recorded refutation-target cannot bind. A later lean needs a different premise: an owner-requiring lifecycle command, other than read-only `session:start`, whose Codex payload omitted or invalidated `session_id`, with decision code `occupancy-identity-unavailable`, and that decision is what stopped the Phase 2 replace. The issue body has the read-only start and a paraphrase. It has no such decision.

Road not taken. The strongest rejected reading is that a missing payload `session_id` still sits upstream: mutation `session:start` would deny, ritual would stay unbound, and the seed would stay. That chain exists on the owner-requiring arm. It is a different premise from the recorded sentence, which names Phase 1, the lifecycle command the session already ran, and a Codex session with no host identity. What flips this verdict is a hook decision in envelope for that owner-requiring command on this session.

Identity and shared state. The control already in the tree is payload `session_id` for Codex, no owner on read-only `session:start`, and the identity deny only for owner-requiring lifecycle commands and for direct writes against a live lease.

footnote

Evidence. Pinned at b6425115eab5a25877735acd70ca7d693594dda8. Stop 1 comment 5782790532 names P1 as the persistence hole: the lifecycle owner bind refuses, and the project identity file never updates. Successor lean 5786133015 places that pain on issue 4663. Comment 5783900527 binds a writer that stores the Phase 2 narrative strings Overview, TechStack, Strategy, Quality, ProjectRules, and Branching in xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json while xbrief/active/ is empty. That same bullet keeps the write off an agent patch of that file and leaves policy keys unset. Synthesis comment 5784060517 accepts that lean. Issue 4663 is closed completed. At this pin, createSkeleton copies empty SKELETON_NARRATIVES and takes no interview text (packages/core/src/render/project-render.ts:244; packages/core/src/render/constants.ts:104). seedMinimalProjectDefinition leaves an existing file intact (packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.ts:261). An agent patch of xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json sits outside REQUIREMENTS_DEFAULT_ALLOW_PATHS (packages/core/src/session/posture.ts:41) and is denied `write-requirements-out-of-class` (dispatcher.ts:1635). With an empty active set that patch is denied `scope-not-ready` (packages/core/src/hooks/scope.ts:247; dispatcher.ts:1983). Session start with an empty active set returns exit 0 (packages/core/src/session/session-start-hook.ts:84). The harvested bound remedy stays that writer on issue 4663.

Close comment 5785028772 names landing commits 5ba75913e and c96cc0122. Those objects are absent from this pin. Coverage here is accepted lean 5783900527 together with the pin-read above.

metadata.issueBody:
## Tester 1 (Codex / Windows / @deftai/directive@0.119.1)

**Checks:** C5 FAIL
**Defect:** 7

### Expected
Completing setup Phase 1 writes USER.md, updates PROJECT-DEFINITION, and produces a proposed work brief.

### What happened
Codex started `deft session:start -- --read-only`. After the interview: "Saving is blocked... this Codex session lacks the host-provided session identity required for writes." USER.md **was** written to `%APPDATA%\deft\USER.md` anyway. PROJECT-DEFINITION stayed the empty init seed. `xbrief/proposed/` only `.gitkeep`. Agent told the user to resume in a session with hook registered and host session ID - hooks were already trusted and still failing.

### Evidence
Codex TUI message; dir timestamps (USER.md 2:24 vs PD 2:09).

### Environment
Directive 0.119.1. Codex TUI Windows.

expected_outputs: host-session-identity tests pass for four-token read-only session:start
setup skill Phase 1 remains the USER.md write
